title: Living for the Will of God
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Peter opens this chapter with a soldier's word and then does something nobody expects with it. He straps the armor to your mind. The weapon is the settled resolve Jesus carried into the garden, and once you have decided you would rather suffer than sin, sin runs out of leverage. It can no longer buy you with comfort or scare you with pain. From there Peter draws a line down the middle of your life and tells you what the rest of your time is for.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 4
